about: Images of this lane beside mcp-surface-corpus's own (its images.json), pinned by the digest of the multi-platform index. rust-build: the Rust toolchain (rust:1.99.1-bookworm, the full Debian 12 image: cc, make, pkg-config and the OpenSSL headers a crate's build script may need) for `cargo install` of a crate (loop/launch.mjs cargoPlan); the server then runs in the same image, which has the libraries it linked against. Recorded 25 Nov 2026 (1.99.1 published 6 Nov 2026); change only by a reviewed commit.
